hooks.command: mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/logs" && jq -c '{time: (now|todate), session: .session_id, event: "prompt", prompt: .prompt}' >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/logs/claude-session-log.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true

mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/logs" && jq -c --arg root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/" '{time: (now|todate), session: .session_id, event: "file-change", tool: .tool_name, file: (.tool_input.file_path | ltrimstr($root))} + (if .tool_name == "Edit" then {old: .tool_input.old_string, new: .tool_input.new_string} else {lines: (.tool_input.content | split("\n") | length)} end)' >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/logs/claude-session-log.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
